verification_policy.paper_results: Author-reported; methods and relevant limitations read directly, no independent experimental replication.
verification_policy.negative_claims: Not found in the inspected method is not proof of implementation absence or impossibility.
verification_policy.archive: No complete raw source archive or content digest in this ledger; pinned URLs and section locators retained.
verification_policy.literature_novelty_verdict: Unestablished as a new principle/protocol; bounded comparative application case-study contribution remains a falsifiable candidate.

sources.title: CPython asyncio.threads
sources.author_claim: Run a callable in a separate thread and propagate its context.
sources.our_read_verified: Function copies context and awaits loop.run_in_executor(None, func_call).
sources.overlap: Native execution mechanism used by the study backend.
sources.distinct_test_axis: Actual app effect and stop-confirmation ordering, not a new executor mechanism.
unknowns: Other Python versions and native providers are not established by this source.

sources.title: CPython concurrent.futures Future.cancel
sources.version: v3.14.3 source; live documentation identified itself as Python 3.14.7
sources.author_claim: A running or completed future cannot be cancelled by cancel().
sources.our_read_verified: The running/finished branch returns False under the future condition lock.
sources.overlap: Awaiter cancellation does not by itself prove a started synchronous worker stopped.
sources.distinct_test_axis: Observe awaiter and worker separately inside the actual app chain.
unknowns: A custom cooperative backend may behave differently.

sources.title: DeerFlow skill-sync cancellation issue and merged fix
sources.author_claim: Drain blocking sync before releasing the execution lease, including repeated cancellation.
sources.our_read_verified: Diff replaces bare to_thread with lifecycle helper; regression observes cleanup entry after worker completion. Tests were read, not executed.
sources.overlap: Direct agent-runtime precedent for the accepted-worker cancellation gap.
sources.distinct_test_axis: Fairly compare drain's quiescent confirmation against effect revocation and retained useful work.
unknowns: Reported CI and provider behavior were not independently reproduced.

sources.title: VERA: Authority-Preserving Edge Revocation for Federated AI-Agent Workflows
sources.author_claim: Exact authority-preserving edge-revocation targets with signed, verifier-checkable evidence.
sources.our_read_verified: Runtime traces become signed delegation decisions for target replay; observed-prefix trust and out-of-scope propagation are explicit.
sources.overlap: Scoped revocation, independently authorized work preservation, framework-grounded evidence.
sources.distinct_test_axis: Already-admitted native effect and confirmation ordering rather than target-set correctness.
unknowns: No end-to-end propagation or native-write stop result is established by the cited replay sections; no claim about every possible adapter.

sources.title: Heartbeat-Bound Hierarchical Credentials: Cryptographic Revocation for AI Agent Swarms
sources.author_claim: Heartbeat freshness bounds descendant authentication after parent shutdown under key-protection and clock assumptions.
sources.our_read_verified: Definition uses authentication success; experiments include real LLM tasks and auth-wrapped tool calls, not merely simulation.
sources.overlap: Post-shutdown authorized action, usability and authentication overhead.
sources.distinct_test_axis: Our proposed accepted-call/stop/later-native-effect ordering is not separately resolved by the cited result descriptions.
unknowns: In-flight call revalidation/atomicity needs code or new evidence; the paper was not tested as an experimental arm.

sources.title: When May an Agent Stop? Evidence-Carrying Termination for Tool-Using LLMs
sources.version: arXiv:2608.23623v1, 2026-08-22; this retrieved v1 includes a section labelled fresh V2 study
sources.author_claim: A typed deterministic verifier authorizes supported terminal completion under a trusted contract and adapter.
sources.our_read_verified: Effects are explicitly outside the certificate; closed-loop synthetic mutations are in-memory; comparative overhead is reported.
sources.overlap: Bound claims to task receipts; distinguish nominal success from supported result.
sources.distinct_test_axis: Real native effects after cancellation/confirmation, not completion-claim scoring alone.
unknowns: No universal conclusion about ECT adapters or native-effect extensions; provider results not replicated.

sources.title: AgentTrust: Runtime Safety Evaluation and Interception for AI Agent Tool Use
sources.author_claim: Structured runtime safety verdicts before tool action.
sources.our_read_verified: Measures labelled action verdicts and latency; trusted in-process enforcement and static-analysis limitations are explicit.
sources.overlap: Tool boundaries, auditability and false-block cost.
sources.distinct_test_axis: Withdraw a formerly legitimate admitted operation; observe native effect timing.
unknowns: Cited methods do not separately settle the admitted-worker scenario; no implementation impossibility claim or local replication.

sources.title: The Chubby lock service for loosely-coupled distributed systems
sources.author_claim: Receiving services validate sequencers to reject delayed requests with stale lock ownership.
sources.our_read_verified: Sequencer checks and weaker lock-delay fallback are described directly in the original text.
sources.overlap: Effect-side stale-authority checks are long-established prior art.
sources.distinct_test_axis: A bounded agent-app comparison, not a new fencing primitive or distributed Chubby implementation.
unknowns: Screenshot calls exposed no image payload here; relevant PDF text inspected without layout claims.
